web.description:
![sub2api](https://github.com/Wei-Shaw.png?size=128)

# sub2api
Quick Install [View Source](https://github.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api)

`git clone https://github.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api.git`

## How to Use
Follow the [official setup guide]([https://github.com/sub2api/sub2api](https://github.com/sub2api/sub2api)) to configure your API keys for supported providers (Claude, OpenAI, etc.).","Specify the backend provider in your prompt.

## Alternative Install (Git Clone)
`git clone https://github.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api`

## Prompt Template
```
Use Sub2API to [TASK] with [SERVICE_PROVIDER] as the backend. Example: 'Use Sub2API to summarize the following research paper and extract key findings into a bullet-point list, using OpenAI as the backend model.' Include the text or data you want processed in your prompt.
```
